== Build notes – 2016 preview artwork ==
The recovered 4 May launch PDF shows a hexagonal First Order icon with spokes. In the May 19 reissue and August master it is circular with inward teeth. Gameplay text, lore and stats match. The separate Seattle white-border foil is listed by the prize checklist and has no confirmed face available.
